description.value:
Duration constant

Your Idol grows stronger and can act more independently in a fight.

Your Idol gains an additional familiar ability, and it may take 1 action on your turn without you spending an action to command it. It uses your proficiencies for any check it makes. It cannot Cast a Spell or use an ability that requires your Zeal on this free action.
